$comment: RFC 0199 §C.1/§E.1 — oauth gains the credentialInterrupt facet (presence semantics, RFC 0192) and providers[] gains issuer + pkce. Hand-decided: grants/providers are otherwise the v1 seed.

grants.description: OAuth 2.0 grant types the host performs on a node's behalf (oauth.md §Token lifecycle).

providers.description: Provider catalog the host can acquire tokens for. A connector node's `auth.provider` MUST match an `id` here.

issuer.description: RFC 0199 §A.4. The provider's authorization-server issuer identifier (RFC 8414 / RFC 9207). Absent ⇒ the host uses a provider-unique redirect URI (RFC 9700 §4.4.2.2).

pkce.description: RFC 0199 §A.1. Absent or `S256` ⇒ the host sends PKCE S256. `unsupported` ⇒ the host sends no PKCE for this provider; such a provider cannot back an MCP reach.

credentialInterrupt.description: RFC 0199 §C.1 (oauth.md §The credential interrupt). Present ⇒ the host suspends a node on a `credential` interrupt instead of failing it when no credential resolves or refresh fails terminally. Absent ⇒ it fails the node with `connector_auth_expired`.
